data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the pump on your local network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the pump on your local network.
data_description.switch_entity: Smart plug or switch that powers the pump. While it is off, the pump is not polled and its values show as unavailable.
data_description.grid_power_entity: Power sensor of your grid connection, positive when importing and negative when exporting. Needed for the solar mode.
data_description.setpoint: Grid power the solar mode aims for.
data_description.dead_band_lower: Below this grid power the solar mode speeds the pump up.
data_description.dead_band_upper: Above this grid power the solar mode slows the pump down.
data_description.step_up: Largest speed increase applied in one regulation step.
data_description.step_down: Largest speed decrease applied in one regulation step.
data_description.priming_time: After the power switch turns on, the pump runs at its own speed this long before the solar mode takes over.
data_description.speed_change_interval: Minimum time between two speed changes sent to the pump. 0 disables the limit.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the pump. Check the IP address and network.
error.dead_band_range_invalid: Dead band upper bound must be greater than or equal to lower bound.

command_failed.message: The pump did not accept command {command}: {error}
